findings.finding: Generic SPEI index paper incorrectly ranked some SPEIbase versions at draft rank 6, while another version correctly excluded it.
findings.resolution: Apply the same exclusion to every version and add the two actual gridded SPEIbase dataset papers; acquire their counts only after identity review.

findings.finding: Narrative JRC reports were inconsistently classified as data-release DOIs.
findings.resolution: Reclassify all identified report DOIs consistently; retain actual data DOI/PID attribution separately.

findings.finding: A generic MAP gap-fill method and GRACE postprocessing references had inconsistent inclusion across sibling products.
findings.resolution: Apply the predeclared generic-method exclusion consistently; preserve unmatched or absent data-paper counts as unknown.

findings.finding: Some MOD13 vegetation-index entries were labeled ocean/water-body coverage.
findings.resolution: Correct all 16 reviewed MOD13 entries to Global land; normalize synonymous geographic labels for ERA5, NCEP and GLDAS.
